display.name: Readwise
display.summary: Searches and organizes Readwise highlights and Reader documents.
examples: Search my highlights for spaced repetition.

agent.name: readwise
agent.description: Searches and manages the signed-in user's Readwise highlights and Reader library, including documents, metadata, locations, tags, and notes.
agent.owns: You own highlights in Readwise and saved documents in Reader. Search or list before changing library items. Ask before deleting a highlight or bulk-editing documents.
agent.first_for: Readwise highlights and saved Reader documents

tool_descriptions.readwise_search_highlights: Search Readwise highlights using hybrid vector and full-text search.
tool_descriptions.readwise_list_highlights: List Readwise highlights newest first with optional book, tag, and date filters.
tool_descriptions.readwise_create_highlights: Create one or more Readwise highlights, optionally attached to a book or article.
tool_descriptions.readwise_update_highlight: Update a Readwise highlight's text, note, location, or tags.
tool_descriptions.readwise_get_daily_review: Get today's Daily Review highlights selected by Readwise spaced repetition.
tool_descriptions.reader_search_documents: Search the full text of documents in the Reader library.
tool_descriptions.reader_list_documents: List Reader documents with location, category, tag, and recency filters.
tool_descriptions.reader_create_document: Save a URL or an HTML or text document to Reader.
tool_descriptions.reader_get_document_details: Read a Reader document's metadata and full Markdown content.
tool_descriptions.reader_move_documents: Move Reader documents among inbox, later, shortlist, archive, and feed locations.
tool_descriptions.reader_bulk_edit_document_metadata: Edit metadata for multiple Reader documents.
tool_descriptions.reader_export_documents: Start an export of Reader documents as Markdown files in a ZIP archive.
tool_descriptions.reader_get_export_documents_status: Check an export's status and retrieve its download URL when complete.
tool_descriptions.reader_list_tags: List tags in the Reader library.
tool_descriptions.reader_add_tags_to_document: Add tags to a Reader document.
tool_descriptions.reader_remove_tags_from_document: Remove tags from a Reader document.
tool_descriptions.reader_get_document_highlights: Get all highlights belonging to a Reader document.
tool_descriptions.reader_create_highlight: Create a highlight on a Reader document using exact text.
tool_descriptions.reader_add_tags_to_highlight: Add tags to a Reader document highlight.
tool_descriptions.reader_remove_tags_from_highlight: Remove tags from a Reader document highlight.
tool_descriptions.reader_set_highlight_notes: Set the note attached to a Reader document highlight.
